name: stat
title: Stat
description: One figure, what it measures and how it moved.
use: A headline number on a dashboard or at the top of a page: a quiet label, the value in large tabular figures and an optional change beside it. It has no surface of its own: put it in a card, or set several in a row.

instead.when: A few numbers on one scale are compared with each other
The figure is a reading within a known range, such as a quota
They are facts in words about one thing, not a figure to watch

classes.name: stat-row
classes.description: The value and its change, on one baseline

classes.name: stat-value
classes.description: The figure, in large tabular numerals

classes.name: stat-delta
classes.description: How the figure moved; a neutral note without a direction

classes.name: stat-delta-up
classes.description: An arrow that points up and the success ink

classes.name: stat-delta-down
classes.description: An arrow that points down and the danger ink

classes.name: stat-description
classes.description: A line under the figure: the period, the comparison or the target

example:
Requests

1.28M

12.4%
